317-1475-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

4247-4681-5170-8175.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

1339-5572-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5572-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4268-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4268-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

849-997-2738-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

413-824-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
413-824-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-824-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

1084-4153.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
1084-4153.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1. The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Flourishing Defenses and Resourceful Defense.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Resolve the Flourishing Defenses trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
1084-4153.notes: You can alternatively start the combo with one creature that has toughness equal to 1 and another creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it. If you do, kill the creature with a -1/-1 counter on it to start the combo.

277-3129-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-1308-4094-4826-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

4399-4770-6747-7818.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
4399-4770-6747-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Sami.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6747-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

877-2921-3081-3817.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5189-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

219-3953-4050.description:
Cast Cartouche of Solidarity by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Cartouche of Solidarity enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Cartouche of Solidarity attached to it, adding {W}.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling Cartouche of Solidarity from your graveyard with the ability to cast it until the end of your next turn.
Cast Cartouche of Solidarity by paying {W}, attaching it to the Warrior made in step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3129-3257-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3129-3257-3875-4231.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

7066-7282-7340.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

512-1355-4241.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
512-1355-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-1355-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

997-1778-4053-6989.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3305-3817-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1339-5780-6625.description:
Cast Matoya by paying {2}{U}.
When Matoya enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Gossip's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

586-5258-5618-5686-6556.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {0}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

851-1251-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-1117-1976-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1322-2457-4289-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4094-4452-4508-5880.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control another nonland permanent.
4094-4452-4508-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

955-1069-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
955-1069-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

4499-4893-5422.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking The Third Doctor.
When The Third Doctor enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3000-4321-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 3.
3000-4321-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token, a Food token and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Repeat step 1 one additional time.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
3000-4321-5670.notes: Once you have infinite life, you may forego sacrificing the Foods and/or Treasures.

974-1558-1953.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-1558-1953.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing all tokens you control to become copies of the Smaug token.
Put all but one Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Myr dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

549-1512-1651.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster and another artifact, targeting Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token that is also an artifact due to Biotransference.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

141-2034-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Ascend from Avernus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ascend from Avernus, returning all creature and planeswalker cards with mana value four or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3948-4603.description: Maralen prevents players from drawing cards. The ability to search libraries will be rendered moot for opponents due to Stranglehold.
